page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 2 physical cores, featuring a single thread per core. It is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated graphics processing units. Consequently, persistent storage must be provisioned via network-attached block storage volumes, and the server is not configured for GPU-accelerated tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing stable and predictable processing performance.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.s2.large offers a balanced entry-level compute profile. It is suitable for workloads such as lightweight web serving, microservices, small-scale application hosting, and development or testing environments that require consistent CPU performance without the variability associated with burstable, shared-core instances.
